name: falcon-bridge
description: Use Falcon (work tracker for audit and due diligence) from Claude: engagements, work papers, review points, RFI, work plans and readiness. Falcon must be open in your browser.
long_description: Relays tool calls to the Falcon app open in your browser on this computer, so Claude can do everything Falcon's in-app assistant can. The bridge stores nothing and runs on this computer only (127.0.0.1). Every change shows in Falcon under Settings → AI connections, with Undo.

pairing_code.title: Pairing code
pairing_code.description: From Falcon: Settings → AI connections → Pairing code.

port.title: Port
port.description: Local port for Falcon to connect to. Change only if 47820 is taken, and use the same port in Falcon.
